from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":466,"var":"chr","code":"if (isstring(chr)) return lex_string;","note":"A simple key=value line is parsed as a generic string token before the '=' separator."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_string","line":304,"var":"chr","code":"do { chr = next(lexer); ... } while (isstring(chr));","note":"The string lexer walks attacker bytes until a delimiter or EOF ends the token."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_key_value","line":510,"var":"parser->buffer","code":"while (lexeme_buffer_consume(&parser->buffer, &lexeme)) { ... }","note":"Buffered string tokens are copied into the parser scratch buffer for key construction."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_key_value","line":581,"var":"line.value","code":"line.value = line.key + key_size + 1;","note":"The parser derives the value pointer from the constructed key buffer and then emits the line."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace updated')
